article_content: 'Imagine a computer crafting meals tailored precisely to your palate.  IBM is working on a system to make this a reality.  It analyzes the chemical makeup of foods, considering how compounds interact. This data is then combined with information on what makes flavors enjoyable, creating recipes designed specifically for you.  IBM scientist Lav Varshney believes this technology could revolutionize healthy eating. By optimizing flavor, it could encourage better nutrition and accommodate individual dietary needs, like low-sodium or excluding certain ingredients. Varshney suggests the system could know our preferences better than we do.  This innovative approach, he explains, starts with understanding the molecular basis of taste.'

article_content: 'Following months of discussions with the BBC, North Korea is contemplating introducing three British television programs – 'Dr. Who,' 'Top Gear,' and 'Teletubbies' – to its tightly controlled state television.  Korean Central Television, which broadcasts for a limited time daily, currently dedicates a significant portion of its airtime to government propaganda and worker motivation.  This potential shift towards including entertainment programs follows a BBC and UK Foreign Office backed initiative aimed at broadening North Korea’s exposure to the outside world. While programs deemed 'too political' were rejected, these three entertainment shows, one specifically for children, were shortlisted.  A source in Pyongyang revealed that North Korean officials have been making 'extensive inquiries' about the shows’ suitability. Though no timeline for a final decision has been given, it is anticipated that shows like 'Top Gear' might face censorship before airing, unlike 'Teletubbies.'  Foreign Secretary William Hague previously expressed support for such initiatives, viewing them as a means to improve understanding of the external world within this isolated nation.'

article_content: 'In January 2014, a 35-year-old man, using the alias 'sheffieldguy,' posted on the parenting forum Mumsnet seeking casual sexual encounters. He described himself as 6ft tall, athletic, and well-endowed, explicitly stating his disinterest in a relationship.  The post quickly garnered over 400 replies, mostly from women who ridiculed his approach. Mumsnet moderators deleted the post, substituting it with a humorous limerick. The incident spread to Twitter, further amplifying the mockery. This event followed a similar viral Mumsnet post from October 2013, where a woman's inquiry about post-coital hygiene practices sparked widespread amusement and discussion under the hashtag #penisbeaker.'

article_content: 'A CNN/Opinion Research Corporation poll from February 2010 revealed that two-thirds of Americans felt Republicans in Congress weren't cooperating sufficiently with President Obama.  However, the public also believed Democrats should initiate bipartisan cooperation, making greater concessions than Republicans.  While 67% of respondents indicated the GOP's lack of cooperation, a notable increase since April, 52% also felt Obama wasn't doing enough, a significant jump of 16 points since April.  This contrasts sharply with his earlier honeymoon phase, according to CNN Polling Director Keating Holland. Although more people attributed the lack of cooperation to Republicans, 54% believed Democrats should lead the charge in finding bipartisan solutions.  Furthermore, over half felt Democrats should be prepared to compromise more.  This public sentiment suggests, according to Holland, that while Democrats might not be entirely to blame for the gridlock, their control of the government puts the onus on them to resolve it.  A separate CNN poll indicated overwhelming public belief in a broken government, yet also maintained hope for its restoration.  The poll surveyed 1,023 adults via telephone with a +/- 3% margin of error.'
translated_content: 'फेब्रुअरी २०१० मा गरिएको CNN/ओपिनियन रिसर्च कर्पोरेसनको सर्वेक्षणले दुई तिहाइ अमेरिकीहरूले कंग्रेसका रिपब्लिकनहरूले राष्ट्रपति ओबामासँग पर्याप्त सहकार्य नगरेको महसुस गरेको देखाएको छ। यद्यपि, जनताले डेमोक्र्याटहरूले द्विपक्षीय सहकार्यको सुरुवात गर्नुपर्ने र रिपब्लिकनहरूभन्दा बढी सम्झौता गर्नुपर्ने पनि विश्वास गरेका थिए। ६७% उत्तरदाताहरूले GOP ले पर्याप्त सहकार्य नगरेको बताएका छन्, जुन अप्रिलदेखि उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि हो, ५२% ले ओबामा पनि पर्याप्त काम नगरेको महसुस गरे, जुन अप्रिलदेखि १६ अंकको उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि हो। CNN का पोलिंग निर्देशक केटिङ हल्यान्डका अनुसार यो उनको सुरुवाती 'हनिमून पिरियड' को तुलनामा एकदमै फरक छ। धेरै मानिसहरूले रिपब्लिकनहरूलाई सहकार्यको कमीको दोष दिए पनि ५४% ले डेमोक्र्याटहरूले द्विपक्षीय समाधान खोज्ने काममा नेतृत्व लिनुपर्ने विश्वास गरे। यसबाहेक, आधाले भन्दा बढीले डेमोक्र्याटहरू बढी सम्झौता गर्न तयार हुनुपर्ने महसुस गरे। हल्यान्डका अनुसार यस जनमतले डेमोक्र्याटहरू गतिरोधका लागि पूर्ण रूपमा दोषी नभए पनि सरकारको नियन्त्रण उनीहरूसँग भएकाले यसलाई समाधान गर्ने जिम्मेवारी उनीहरूको हो भन्ने संकेत गर्छ। CNN को छुट्टै सर्वेक्षणले धेरैजसो जनताले सरकार बिग्रेको विश्वास गरे पनि यसलाई सुधार्न सकिन्छ भन्ने आशा राखेका छन् भन्ने देखाएको छ। यो सर्वेक्षण १०२३ वयस्क अमेरिकीहरूमा टेलिफोनमार्फत गरिएको थियो र यसको नतिजामा +/- ३% को फरक पर्न सक्छ।'

article_content: 'Across Europe, citizens are expressing growing frustration with their leaders, traditional political parties, and the prevailing austerity measures.  Recent elections reflect this discontent, with voters turning to alternative and often extreme political options.  In Greece, support for far-left and far-right parties has surged, while France elected a president who campaigned on reversing austerity policies. Similar trends are evident in the UK, Italy, and even Germany, where Chancellor Angela Merkel faced a setback in state elections. While Europe has made strides in stabilizing its financial system, the economic and employment outlook remains challenging, prompting a shift in focus from austerity to growth.  However, the path forward is fraught with difficulties, particularly for Greece, which faces stark choices about its future within the eurozone.  High unemployment rates, especially among young people, continue to fuel social and political instability across Europe. Countries like Spain and Italy are grappling with mounting debt and economic contraction, leading to difficult decisions about spending cuts and tax increases.  As former British Prime Minister John Major warned, the severity of the economic medicine required may prove difficult for liberal democracies to endure.'

article_content: 'Jean Charles de Menezes, a Brazilian electrician, was mistakenly shot and killed by anti-terror police in July 2005.  His family, along with at least 12 others, including relatives of Cherry Groce and Ricky Reel, were allegedly spied on by undercover Scotland Yard's Special Demonstration Squad (SDS).  The SDS collected information on the families while they campaigned for justice.  Ricky Reel died in 1997 after falling into the Thames, and Cherry Groce's shooting by police sparked the 1985 Brixton riots. A report by Derbyshire Chief Constable Mick Creedon criticizes the now-disbanded SDS for gathering and retaining information about these families that was irrelevant to crime prevention. The report suggests this was done to potentially discredit their campaigns.  The de Menezes family received around £100,000 in compensation and may receive more depending on the extent of the intrusion.  Sukhdev Reel, Ricky Reel's mother, expressed anger and a sense of violated dignity, while the Jean Charles de Menezes Family Campaign questioned the police's motives. Diane Abbott MP stated the spying claims severely damage public trust in the police.'

article_content: Madison Bumgarner won the World Series MVP award and received a 2015 Chevy Colorado.  Ironically, all 2015 Chevy Colorado pickups have been recalled due to a potential driver's side airbag defect that could prevent proper deployment.  GM has halted production until the issue is resolved. A GM executive's awkward on-air remarks about the truck, where he touted its 'class-leading, um, you know, technology and stuff,' went viral, especially given the unmentioned recall.  According to Automotive News, production of the Chevy Colorado and GMC Canyon was stopped about two weeks after shipments began.  GM notified dealers, stating the defect 'will cause the driver-side airbags to not function as designed and may adversely affect their crash performance.'  However, GM assures the vehicles are safe to drive pending repair. Bumgarner's World Series performance was legendary, including five crucial innings in relief in Game Seven against the Kansas City Royals, securing the Giants' victory.  He pitched a record-breaking 52 2/3 postseason innings, including two World Series starts where he allowed only one run.  His Game Five performance was a complete game shutout.  Remarkably, he returned on short rest for relief in Game Seven, pitching scoreless innings to secure the win. The Giants won only one World Series game without Bumgarner pitching.
translated_content: म्याडिसन बमगारनरले वर्ल्ड सिरिज एमभीपी जितेर २०१५ को शेभ्रो कोलोराडो प्राप्त गरे। विडम्बनाको कुरा, सबै २०१५ शेभ्रो कोलोराडो पिकअपहरू ड्राइभर साइडको एयरब्यागमा खराबीको कारण फिर्ता बोलाइएको छ, जसले गर्दा यो राम्रोसँग नखुल्न सक्छ। समस्या समाधान नभएसम्म जीएमले उत्पादन बन्द गरेको छ। एक जीएम कार्यकारीको ट्रकको बारेमा दिएको अनौठो भाषण, जहाँ उनले यसको 'कक्षा-अग्रणी, उम, थाहा छ, प्रविधि र यस्तै कुरा' भनेर चर्चा गरे, भाइरल भयो, खासगरि उल्लेख नगरिएको फिर्ताको कारण। अटोमोटिभ न्यूजका अनुसार, शेभ्रो कोलोराडो र जीएमसी क्यान्यनको उत्पादन ढुवानी सुरु भएको लगभग दुई हप्तापछि रोकियो। जीएमले डिलरहरूलाई खराबीको बारेमा जानकारी दिँदै भन्यो,'यो अवस्थाले ड्राइभर-साइड एयरब्यागहरू डिजाइन अनुसार काम नगर्ने र ड्राइभर-साइड एयरब्यागहरूको दुर्घटना प्रदर्शनमा नकारात्मक असर पार्न सक्छ।' यद्यपि, जीएमले मर्मत नभएसम्म गाडीहरू चलाउन सुरक्षित रहेको आश्वासन दिएको छ। बमगारनरको वर्ल्ड सिरिज प्रदर्शन अविस्मरणीय थियो, जसमा कान्सास सिटी रोयल्स विरुद्धको खेल ७ मा ५ महत्वपूर्ण इनिङहरू समावेश थिए, जसले जायन्ट्सको जित सुनिश्चित गर्यो। उनले ५२ २/३ पोस्टसिजन इनिङहरू पिच गरे, जसमा दुई वर्ल्ड सिरिज सुरुवातहरू समावेश छन् जहाँ उनले केवल एक रन दिए। उनको खेल ५ को प्रदर्शन पूर्ण खेल शून्य रन थियो। उल्लेखनीय कुरा के छ भने, उनी खेल ७ मा छोटो विश्राममै राहतको लागि फर्किए र जित सुनिश्चित गर्न स्कोररहित इनिङहरू पिच गरे। बमगारनर बिना जायन्ट्सले केवल एक वर्ल्ड सिरिज खेल जितेका थिए।

article_content: 'In Hong Kong, teenage activist Joshua Wong, along with two members of the student group Scholarism, has initiated a hunger strike. Their aim is to compel the government to engage in discussions regarding democratic reforms. Wong conveyed to CNN that this drastic measure is a last resort to exert pressure on the government for a meeting. He stated the hunger strike would cease if the government agrees to discuss immediate political reform with Scholarism.  Wong advocates for open elections for Hong Kong's leadership, contrasting with Beijing's stance that only candidates nominated by a committee should be eligible.  This hunger strike unfolds amidst growing divisions within the protest movement, which has occupied a major highway in Admiralty for over two months.  Government officials remain unyielding. Chief Executive C.Y. Leung's response to the hunger strike was to advise students to prioritize their health in the cooling weather.  Public reaction to Wong's hunger strike is varied, from skepticism about its effectiveness to accusations of it being a tactical retreat. Scholarism's statement acknowledges the desperation of the measure, expressing weariness but also a determination to pursue their democratic ideals.  This is not Scholarism's first hunger strike; a previous one in 2012 successfully opposed a pro-Communist curriculum in schools.  Meanwhile, the founders of the Occupy Central movement announced their intention to surrender to police, advising students to withdraw.  However, student leaders like Alex Chow, who apologized for a failed attempt to disrupt government operations, seem more focused on dialogue with the government.  Police clashed with protesters attempting to surround government buildings, leading to arrests and injuries. The government condemned the protesters' actions as violent and radical.  While the main protest site faces potential clearance, protesters are uncertain about their next steps.  Disagreements have arisen between student leaders and demonstrators regarding strategy, with some advocating for escalated confrontation while others, including Occupy founders, suggest a strategic retreat, citing dwindling public support reflected in recent polls.'
translated_content: 'हङकङमा, किशोर कार्यकर्ता जोशुवा वोंगले स्कॉलरिज्मका दुई सदस्यसहित अनशन सुरु गरेका छन्। उनीहरूको उद्देश्य सरकारलाई लोकतान्त्रिक सुधारका बारेमा छलफल गर्न बाध्य पार्नु हो। वोंगले सीएनएनलाई बताए कि यो कठोर कदम सरकारसँग बैठकको लागि दबाब दिनको लागि अन्तिम उपाय हो। उनले भने कि यदि सरकार स्कॉलरिज्मसँग तत्काल राजनीतिक सुधारका बारेमा छलफल गर्न सहमत भएमा अनशन अन्त्य हुनेछ। वोंगले हङकङको नेतृत्वका लागि खुला चुनावको वकालत गर्छन्, जुन बेइजिङको अडानभन्दा विपरीत छ जसमा समितिले मनोनयन गरेका उम्मेदवारहरू मात्र योग्य हुनुपर्छ। यो अनशन आन्दोलनभित्र बढ्दो विभाजनको बीचमा भएको छ, जसले एडमिरल्टीमा दुई महिनाभन्दा बढी समयदेखि मुख्य राजमार्ग ओगटेको छ। सरकारी अधिकारीहरू अडिग छन्।  कार्यकारी प्रमुख सी.वाई. लेउङले अनशनको प्रतिक्रियामा विद्यार्थीहरूलाई चिसो मौसममा आफ्नो स्वास्थ्यलाई प्राथमिकता दिन सल्लाह दिए। वोंगको अनशनप्रति सार्वजनिक प्रतिक्रिया फरक छ, यसको प्रभावकारिताको बारेमा शंकादेखि यसलाई रणनीतिक पछि हट्ने आरोपसम्म। स्कॉलरिज्मको वक्तव्यले यस उपायको निराशालाई स्वीकार गर्दछ, थकान व्यक्त गर्दछ तर उनीहरूको लोकतान्त्रिक आदर्शहरू पछ्याउने दृढ संकल्प पनि। यो स्कॉलरिज्मको पहिलो अनशन होइन; २०१२ मा भएको एउटा अनशनले विद्यालयहरूमा साम्यवादी समर्थक पाठ्यक्रमको विरोध गरेको थियो। यसैबीच, अकुपाई सेन्ट्रल आन्दोलनका संस्थापकहरूले प्रहरीमा समर्पण गर्ने आफ्नो मनसाय घोषणा गरे, विद्यार्थीहरूलाई फिर्ता हुन सल्लाह दिए। यद्यपि, एलेक्स चाउ जस्ता विद्यार्थी नेताहरू, जसले सरकारी कारबाहीहरूलाई बाधा पुर्‍याउने असफल प्रयासको लागि माफी मागे, सरकारसँगको संवादमा बढी केन्द्रित देखिन्छन्। सरकारी भवनहरू घेर्न खोज्ने प्रदर्शनकारीहरूसँग प्रहरीको झडप भयो, जसले गर्दा गिरफ्तारी र चोटपटक लागेको थियो। सरकारले प्रदर्शनकारीहरूको कार्यलाई हिंसात्मक र कट्टरपन्थी भनेर निन्दा गरेको छ। मुख्य प्रदर्शन स्थल खाली हुने सम्भावनाको सामना गर्दा, प्रदर्शनकारीहरू आफ्नो अर्को कदमको बारेमा अनिश्चित छन्।  रणनीतिबारे विद्यार्थी नेता र प्रदर्शनकारीबीच असहमति उत्पन्न भएको छ, कसैले बढ्दो टकरावको वकालत गर्छन् भने अरूले, अकुपाईका संस्थापकहरू लगायत, हालैका सर्वेक्षणहरूमा कम सार्वजनिक समर्थनलाई उद्धृत गर्दै रणनीतिक पछि हट्न सुझाव दिन्छन्।'

article_content: Fifteen-year-old Sydney Kirk, from Olney, Maryland, decided to experiment by briefly stopping her ADHD medication in eighth grade. She'd been taking it since third grade but felt it made her shy and unlike herself.  Noticing a positive change, she confided in her parents, and after consulting her doctor, they agreed she could discontinue the medication. Though her concentration and grades dipped slightly, everyone involved is pleased with the outcome. Sydney's mother, Julie, emphasizes their focus on improved study habits. This situation raises important questions for parents: when are ADHD medications necessary, and if started, when might a child stop? In 2006, the CDC estimated 4.5 million children and teens had ADHD.  Dr. James Waxmonsky, a child psychiatrist at the University at Buffalo, stresses collaborative decision-making regarding ADHD treatment. He encourages parents to explore non-drug options like behavioral therapies and coping mechanisms, citing their long-term effectiveness. Additionally, Consumer Reports advises caution with free drug samples, often for pricier medications, potentially leading to higher long-term costs. Generic options can save thousands annually.  Dr. John Santa from Consumer Reports notes these medications are often long-term commitments.  Waxmonsky adds that different medications suit different individuals and recommends discussing expected outcomes with doctors.  He also cautions about the timing of any 'medication vacations,' advising against stopping during stressful academic periods.
translated_content: मेरिल्याण्डको ओल्नीकी पन्ध्र वर्षीया सिड्नी कर्कले आठौं कक्षामा आफ्नो एडीएचडी औषधि छोटो समयको लागि रोक्ने निर्णय गरिन्। उनले तेस्रो कक्षा देखि यो औषधि सेवन गर्दै आएकी थिइन् तर यसले उनलाई लजालु बनाएको र आफू जस्तो नभएको महसुस गरिन्। सकारात्मक परिवर्तन देखेपछि, उनले आफ्ना आमाबुबालाई यसबारे बताइन्, र आफ्नो डाक्टरसँग परामर्श गरेपछि, उनीहरूले औषधि बन्द गर्न सहमति जनाए। यद्यपि उनको एकाग्रता र ग्रेडहरू थोरै घटे तापनि, सबै जना यस नतिजाबाट खुसी छन्। सिड्नीकी आमा, जूली, अध्ययन बानी सुधारमा जोड दिन्छिन्। यो स्थितिले आमाबाबुको लागि महत्त्वपूर्ण प्रश्नहरू खडा गर्दछ: एडीएचडी औषधि कहिले आवश्यक हुन्छ, र यदि सुरु गरियो भने, बच्चा कहिले रोक्न सक्छ? २००६ मा, सीडीसीले अनुमान गरेको थियो कि ४५ लाख बच्चाहरू र किशोरकिशोरीहरूलाई एडीएचडी थियो। बफेलो विश्वविद्यालयका बाल मनोचिकित्सक डा. जेम्स वाक्समोन्स्कीले एडीएचडी उपचारको बारेमा सहयोगी निर्णय लिने कुरामा जोड दिन्छन्। उनी औषधि बाहेकका विकल्पहरू जस्तै व्यवहार थेरापी र कोपिङ मेकानिजमहरू अन्वेषण गर्न आमाबाबुलाई प्रोत्साहित गर्दछन्, तिनीहरूको दीर्घकालीन प्रभावकारितालाई उद्धृत गर्दै। थप रूपमा, कन्ज्युमर रिपोर्टहरूले नि:शुल्क औषधि नमूनाहरूसँग सावधानी अपनाउन सल्लाह दिन्छ, प्रायः महँगो औषधिहरूको लागि, सम्भावित रूपमा दीर्घकालीन लागत बढाउने। जेनेरिक विकल्पहरूले वार्षिक हजारौं बचत गर्न सक्छ। कन्ज्युमर रिपोर्टका डा. जोन सान्ताले टिप्पणी गरे कि यी औषधिहरू प्रायः दीर्घकालीन प्रतिबद्धताहरू हुन्। वाक्समोन्स्कीले थप्छन् कि विभिन्न औषधिहरू विभिन्न व्यक्तिहरूलाई उपयुक्त हुन्छन् र डाक्टरहरूसँग अपेक्षित परिणामहरू छलफल गर्न सिफारिस गर्दछन्। उनी कुनै पनि 'औषधि बिदा' को समयको बारेमा पनि सावधानी दिन्छन्, तनावपूर्ण शैक्षिक अवधिमा रोक्न सल्लाह दिंदैनन्।

article_content: 'Marion Bartoli's return to British grass after her Wimbledon triumph ended unexpectedly with a retirement and defeat against 15-year-old Jodie Burrage. Almost a year after winning the Venus Rosewater Dish on Centre Court, Bartoli played in the exhibition Liverpool Hope University International Tennis Tournament.  Her young opponent, Burrage, quickly gained a significant lead, leaving Bartoli visibly rusty. Despite winning some games, Bartoli ultimately retired with a shoulder injury while trailing 7-5, 3-2.  Burrage expressed disbelief at her victory against the former Wimbledon champion. Bartoli, who retired from professional tennis shortly after her Wimbledon win, acknowledged her lack of recent practice. She admitted she could no longer handle the demands of professional tennis but still enjoyed playing recreationally. Bartoli's participation in doubles on Friday was uncertain due to the injury.'

article_content: 'A new study challenges the long-held belief that menopausal mood swings are solely due to hormone fluctuations. Researchers found no connection between estrogen levels and mood in post-menopausal women not receiving hormone therapy.  While progesterone showed a potential link to verbal memory and overall cognitive function in early menopause, it was not associated with mood changes.  This research, published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, is the first to examine the relationship between sex hormones and cognition in both younger and older post-menopausal women, accounting for the time elapsed since menopause.  Led by Professor Victor Henderson of Stanford University, the study involved 643 women aged 41 to 84, divided into groups based on time since menopause. Participants underwent cognitive tests, mood assessments, and hormone level measurements. Contrary to the 'critical window' hypothesis, which suggests hormone effects vary based on proximity to menopause, the study found no significant link between estrogen levels and cognitive function in either group.  While acknowledging the limitations of not directly measuring brain estrogen levels, the study suggests that increasing blood estrogen may not significantly impact cognitive skills in post-menopausal women.'
translated_content: 'एउटा नयाँ अध्ययनले रजोनिवृत्तिको समयमा हुने मुड स्विंग्स हर्मोनको उतारचढावका कारणले मात्र हुन्छ भन्ने धारणालाई चुनौती दिएको छ। हर्मोन थेरापी नलिने रजोनिवृत्ति पछिका महिलाहरूमा गरिएको अध्ययनमा एस्ट्रोजनको स्तर र मुडबीच कुनै सम्बन्ध फेला परेन।  यद्यपि प्रोजेस्टेरोनले रजोनिवृत्तिको सुरुवाती चरणमा मौखिक स्मरणशक्ति र समग्र संज्ञानात्मक कार्यसँग सम्बन्ध देखाएको छ, तर यो मुड परिवर्तनसँग सम्बन्धित पाइएन।  प्रोसिडिङ्स अफ द नेशनल एकेडेमी अफ साइन्सेजमा प्रकाशित यो अनुसन्धान रजोनिवृत्ति भएका युवा र वृद्ध महिलाहरूमा सेक्स हर्मोन र संज्ञानात्मक कार्यबीचको सम्बन्ध अध्ययन गर्ने पहिलो हो, जसले रजोनिवृत्ति भएको समयलाई पनि ध्यानमा राखेको छ।  स्ट्यानफोर्ड विश्वविद्यालयका प्राध्यापक भिक्टर हेन्डरसनको नेतृत्वमा गरिएको यस अध्ययनमा ४१ देखि ८४ वर्ष उमेर समूहका ६४३ महिलाहरू समावेश थिए, जसलाई रजोनिवृत्ति भएको समयको आधारमा समूहमा विभाजन गरिएको थियो। सहभागीहरूको संज्ञानात्मक परीक्षण, मुड मूल्याङ्कन र हर्मोन स्तर मापन गरिएको थियो।  रजोनिवृत्ति पछिको समयको आधारमा हर्मोनको प्रभाव फरक पर्छ भन्ने मान्यतालाई चुनौती दिँदै, यस अध्ययनले दुवै समूहमा एस्ट्रोजनको स्तर र संज्ञानात्मक कार्यबीच कुनै महत्त्वपूर्ण सम्बन्ध फेला पारेन।  मस्तिष्कमा एस्ट्रोजनको स्तर प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा मापन गर्न नसकिने सीमिततालाई स्वीकार गर्दै, अध्ययनले रजोनिवृत्ति पछिका महिलाहरूमा रगतमा एस्ट्रोजनको स्तर बढाउँदा संज्ञानात्मक सीपमा खासै प्रभाव नपर्ने सुझाव दिन्छ।'

article_content: 'A UK housing boom has reached every major city, marking the first time in a decade that the top 20 cities have experienced 5% or more annual house price growth, according to Hometrack.  This growth, previously concentrated in the south, now includes northern cities like Newcastle, Edinburgh, and Glasgow. While London, Bristol, and Cambridge lead with the highest year-on-year growth (18%, 13%, and 12% respectively), their momentum is slowing.  Glasgow and Liverpool show the lowest growth at 5%, but prices there continue to rise.  Despite overall growth, 11 of the 20 cities still report prices below the UK average, with Glasgow and Liverpool significantly trailing at 40% below. London's average house price, exceeding double the national average at over half a million pounds, presents affordability challenges.  Experts predict UK prices will outpace London's next year, citing affordability limitations in the capital. Savills forecasts flat London prices in 2015 against a 10% average rise elsewhere.  Hometrack's Richard Donnell confirms nationwide growth and suggests that London's monthly growth could soon fall behind other major cities.  Official figures highlight rapid price increases in the east and south-east, driven by London workers seeking more affordable housing.  London's 19% annual increase, though below August's peak, contrasts with the East's fastest decade growth at 13% and the South East's near 12% rise.  This outward migration from London, due to high property costs, fuels price increases in surrounding areas.'
translated_content: 'बेलायतको आवास बजारमा आएको उछालले सबै प्रमुख सहरहरूलाई छोएको छ, होमट्र्याकका अनुसार शीर्ष २० सहरहरूले एक दशकमा पहिलो पटक ५% वा सोभन्दा बढी वार्षिक घरको मूल्य वृद्धि अनुभव गरेका छन्। पहिले दक्षिणमा केन्द्रित रहेको यो वृद्धि अब न्युकासल, एडिनबर्ग र ग्लास्गो जस्ता उत्तरी सहरहरूमा पनि देखिएको छ। लन्डन, ब्रिस्टल र क्याम्ब्रिज क्रमशः १८%, १३% र १२% को उच्चतम वर्ष-दर-वर्ष वृद्धिसहित अग्रस्थानमा रहे पनि तिनको गति सुस्त हुँदै गएको छ। ग्लास्गो र लिभरपुलमा ५% ले सबैभन्दा कम वृद्धि देखिएको छ, तर त्यहाँ मूल्यहरू बढिरहेका छन्। समग्र वृद्धि भए तापनि, २० मध्ये ११ सहरहरूले अझै पनि बेलायतको औसतभन्दा कम मूल्यहरू रिपोर्ट गरेका छन्, ग्लास्गो र लिभरपुल ४०% कमसहित पछाडि छन्। लन्डनको औसत घरको मूल्य, राष्ट्रिय औसतभन्दा दोब्बर भन्दा बढी र आधा मिलियन पाउन्डभन्दा माथि भएकोले, किफायती चुनौतीहरू खडा गर्दछ। विज्ञहरूले बेलायतको मूल्यहरू अर्को वर्ष लन्डनको भन्दा बढी हुने अनुमान गरेका छन्, राजधानीमा किफायती सीमाहरू उद्धृत गर्दै। साभिल्सले २०१५ मा लन्डनमा घरको मूल्य स्थिर रहने तर बेलायतका अन्यत्र औसतमा १०% ले वृद्धि हुने पूर्वानुमान गरेको छ। होमट्र्याकका रिचर्ड डोनेलले देशव्यापी वृद्धिको पुष्टि गरेका छन् र लन्डनको मासिक वृद्धि चाँडै नै अन्य प्रमुख सहरहरूभन्दा पछि पर्न सक्ने सुझाव दिएका छन्। आधिकारिक तथ्याङ्कले पूर्व र दक्षिण-पूर्वमा मूल्यमा द्रुत वृद्धि भएको देखाउँछ, किफायती आवास खोज्ने लन्डनका कामदारहरूद्वारा संचालित। लन्डनको १९% वार्षिक वृद्धि, अगस्टको उच्चतम स्तरभन्दा कम भए तापनि, पूर्वको १३% को सबैभन्दा छिटो दशक वृद्धि र दक्षिण-पूर्वको लगभग १२% वृद्धिसँग भिन्न छ। घरजग्गाको उच्च लागतका कारण लन्डनबाट बाहिरिने बसाइँसराइले वरपरका क्षेत्रहरूमा मूल्यवृद्धि बढाएको छ।'

article_content: 'Energy Secretary Ed Davey acknowledged his awareness of John Gummer’s (Lord Deben) involvement in green businesses when appointing him to lead the Climate Change Committee.  This governmental body sets crucial targets for renewable energy and greenhouse gas emissions.  Davey, however, dismissed concerns about a potential conflict of interest, arguing that Gummer’s business interests were limited to ‘infrastructure’ and didn’t extend to renewable energy production. This assertion sparked criticism and was deemed 'absurd' by several individuals.  As previously reported, Lord Deben serves as chairman for both Veolia Water UK, which links wind farms to the National Grid, and the Climate Change Committee. Critics argue that the committee’s ambitious targets are a primary driver behind the National Grid’s substantial planned investments, estimated at £25 billion by 2020, a cost that’s likely contributing to rising household energy bills.  Following public disclosure of Lord Deben’s role at Veolia Water UK, correspondence between Members of Parliament, Lord Deben, and Mr. Davey was released.  In a letter dated May, Davey confirmed his prior knowledge of Veolia’s energy-related operations but reiterated his stance on the absence of any conflict of interest.  Labour MP Graham Stringer, a known climate change skeptic, strongly criticized Davey’s position, claiming that green lobbyists had skewed the country’s energy policies and that the argument about Veolia being solely involved in infrastructure is demonstrably false. Lord Deben has not responded to inquiries regarding his compensation from Veolia or how he intends to avoid decisions within the Climate Change Committee that could potentially benefit the firm.'
translated_content: 'ऊर्जा सचिव एड डेभीले जोन गमर (लर्ड डेबेन) लाई जलवायु परिवर्तन समितिको नेतृत्व गर्न नियुक्त गर्दा हरित व्यवसायमा संलग्न भएको थाहा पाएको स्वीकारे। यस सरकारी निकायले नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा र हरितगृह ग्यास उत्सर्जनका लागि महत्त्वपूर्ण लक्ष्यहरू निर्धारण गर्दछ। यद्यपि, डेभीले सम्भावित स्वार्थको द्वन्द्वको बारेमा चिन्तालाई खारेज गर्दै, गमरको व्यावसायिक स्वार्थ ‘पूर्वाधार’ मा सीमित रहेको र नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा उत्पादनमा विस्तार नभएको तर्क गरे। यो दाबीको आलोचना भयो र धेरै व्यक्तिहरूले ‘बेतुका’ भने। पहिले रिपोर्ट गरिएझैं, लर्ड डेबेनले राष्ट्रिय ग्रिडमा पवन फार्महरू जोड्ने भेओलिया वाटर यूके र जलवायु परिवर्तन समितिका अध्यक्षको रूपमा काम गर्छन्। आलोचकहरूले तर्क गर्छन् कि समितिका महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्यहरू राष्ट्रिय ग्रिडको २०२० सम्ममा २५ अर्ब पाउण्डको पर्याप्त लगानीको लागि एक प्राथमिक चालक हो, जुन लागत बढ्दो घरेलु ऊर्जा बिलमा योगदान पुर्‍याउँछ। भेओलिया वाटर यूकेमा लर्ड डेबेनको भूमिकाको सार्वजनिक खुलासा पछि, संसद सदस्यहरू, लर्ड डेबेन र श्री डेभी बीच पत्राचार जारी गरिएको थियो। मे महिनाको पत्रमा डेभीले भेओलियाको ऊर्जा-सम्बन्धित कार्यहरूको बारेमा आफ्नो पूर्व ज्ञान पुष्टि गरे तर कुनै पनि स्वार्थ बाझिने बारेमा आफ्नो अडान दोहोर्‍याए। एक प्रसिद्ध जलवायु परिवर्तन संशयवादी लेबर सांसद ग्राहम स्ट्रिन्जरले डेभीको अडानको कडा आलोचना गर्दै हरित पैरवीकारहरूले देशको ऊर्जा नीतिलाई तोडेको र भेओलिया केवल पूर्वाधारमा संलग्न भएको तर्क स्पष्ट रूपमा गलत भएको दाबी गरे। लर्ड डेबेनले भेओलियाबाट आफ्नो पारिश्रमिकको बारेमा वा कसरी उनी जलवायु परिवर्तन समिति भित्र निर्णयहरूबाट बच्न चाहन्छन् जसले फर्मलाई फाइदा पुर्‍याउन सक्छ भन्ने बारेमा सोधपुछको जवाफ दिएका छैनन्।'

article_content: 'A recent study reveals Australia's growing obesity problem, ranking it as the 25th highest among 188 nations in a global survey spanning 33 years. Over the past three decades, Australia and New Zealand have seen an 80% surge in obesity, a concerning trend mirrored worldwide, with no country showing a decrease.  This rise places a significant strain on healthcare systems. In Australia, nearly one in three adults are now considered obese, totaling approximately 5.2 million, a stark increase from 16% in 1980. Experts warn that immediate action is required to combat this crisis, advocating for government intervention to curb junk food advertising, improve food labeling, and promote healthier food options.  The study highlights a global concern, with over half of the world's obese population residing in developing nations, and a quarter of children affected by obesity.  The financial implications are substantial, with budget cuts potentially hindering preventative programs. Experts also point to societal factors, suggesting that the gradual nature of the obesity increase has masked its severity, and cost barriers may prevent individuals from seeking medical advice.'
translated_content: 'एउटा हालैको अध्ययनले अस्ट्रेलियाको बढ्दो मोटोपना समस्यालाई उजागर गरेको छ, ३३ वर्षको विश्वव्यापी सर्वेक्षणमा १८८ राष्ट्रहरूमध्ये २५ औं स्थानमा राखेको छ। विगत तीन दशकहरूमा, अस्ट्रेलिया र न्यूजील्याण्डमा मोटोपना ८०% ले बढेको छ, जुन विश्वव्यापी रुपमा चिन्ताजनक प्रवृत्ति हो र कुनै पनि देशमा यसमा कमी देखिएको छैन। यो वृद्धिले स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रणालीमा ठूलो भार पारेको छ। अस्ट्रेलियामा, लगभग तीन जना वयस्क मध्ये एक जनालाई अहिले मोटो मानिन्छ, जुन लगभग ५२ लाख हो र यो संख्या १९८० मा १६% थियो। विज्ञहरूले यो संकटलाई समाधान गर्न तत्काल कारबाही आवश्यक रहेको चेतावनी दिँदै, जंक फूडको विज्ञापन नियन्त्रण गर्न, खाद्य लेबलिङ सुधार गर्न र स्वस्थकर खाद्य विकल्पहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्न सरकारी हस्तक्षेपको वकालत गरेका छन्। अध्ययनले विश्वव्यापी चिन्तालाई प्रकाश पारेको छ, विश्वको आधाभन्दा बढी मोटो जनसंख्या विकासशील राष्ट्रहरूमा बसोबास गर्ने र एक चौथाई बालबालिकाहरू मोटोपनाबाट प्रभावित छन्। बजेट कटौतीले रोकथाम कार्यक्रमहरूलाई बाधा पुर्‍याउन सक्ने भएकाले वित्तीय प्रभावहरू पर्याप्त छन्। विज्ञहरूले सामाजिक कारकहरूलाई पनि औंल्याएका छन् र मोटोपना वृद्धिको क्रमिक प्रकृतिले यसको गम्भीरतालाई ढाकेको छ भन्ने सुझाव दिएका छन्। साथै, लागत अवरोधहरूले व्यक्तिहरूलाई चिकित्सा सल्लाह खोज्नबाट रोक्न सक्छ।'
